technical_and_design_decisions: Represent undeployed as a first-class deployer or stream status, distinct from unknown, and preserve unknown for genuinely unavailable or unrecognized state.
Apply the undeployed determination when an existing stream has no deployment context associated with it.
Implement the status behavior consistently through shared status logic where possible, with deployer-specific adapters only where required.
Create independent repositories for Lattice SPI, Kubernetes SPI, and Mesos SPI, preserving the existing source history where practical.
Use the existing project build conventions, Java version, dependency management, test framework, and CI patterns for each new repository.
Maintain API and serialization compatibility for existing statuses and existing consumers unless the repository structure requires a documented package or dependency update.
Submit the existing Mesos SPI work as a focused pull request after rebasing it onto the extracted Mesos SPI repository.
assumptions: The specification provides no repository layout, implementation details, acceptance criteria, or test fixtures; estimates assume a moderately sized Java SPI codebase with existing unit-test and CI conventions.
The Cloud Foundry, Lattice, Kubernetes, and Mesos SPIs are currently contained in one administrative repository and can be separated without redesigning their public SPI contracts.
Creating a separate repository includes source extraction, build configuration, dependency setup, basic repository metadata, CI configuration, and validation of the resulting build.
The existing Mesos SPI work is substantially complete and requires preparation, rebase, tests, and pull-request packaging rather than a new implementation from scratch.
All deployers in scope are the named Cloud Foundry, Lattice, Kubernetes, and Mesos deployers.
No major changes to external APIs, deployment platforms, authentication, persistence schemas, or runtime infrastructure are required.
Code review turnaround and CI queue time are excluded; effort includes responding to a normal amount of review feedback and fixing defects found during validation.
One workday represents approximately eight hours of focused development effort by one software developer.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the current SPI repository, deployer implementations, status model, stream lifecycle, build configuration, tests, and CI dependencies. Identify extraction boundaries and all code paths that currently produce unknown status.

Define the undeployed status semantics, detection rules for streams without deployment context, compatibility behavior for existing unknown values, package and dependency boundaries, and the target layout of the separate repositories.

activities.activity_name: Prepare and submit existing Mesos SPI work
activities.activity_description: Review the existing Mesos SPI changes, rebase or adapt them to the target repository structure, complete missing tests or build fixes, and prepare the Mesos pull request with appropriate documentation.

activities.activity_name: Create and validate the Lattice SPI repository
activities.activity_description: Extract the Lattice SPI into a standalone repository, configure its build and dependencies, preserve required history and metadata where practical, update references, and verify compilation and tests.

activities.activity_name: Create and validate the Kubernetes SPI repository
activities.activity_description: Extract the Kubernetes SPI into a standalone repository, configure build and CI integration, update package or dependency references, and verify compilation and tests.

activities.activity_name: Create and validate the Mesos SPI repository
activities.activity_description: Extract the Mesos SPI into a standalone repository, integrate the existing Mesos work, configure build and CI metadata, update references, and verify compilation and tests.

Add the undeployed status to the common status representation and implement the shared decision logic for streams that have no deployment context, while retaining existing unknown behavior for other cases.

Apply the new status consistently to Cloud Foundry, Lattice, Kubernetes, and Mesos SPI implementations, including status mapping, serialization or presentation paths, and handling of existing streams without deployment context.

Add or update unit and integration tests for undeployed, unknown, deployed, and context-present scenarios across all deployers; add repository extraction/build regression coverage and run the complete test suites.

activities.activity_name: Documentation, CI, dependency, and integration updates
activities.activity_description: Update README files, repository documentation, build manifests, CI jobs, dependency references, parent-project references, and migration notes needed after separating the SPI repositories.

activities.activity_name: Final review, defect correction, and delivery validation
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end local validation, inspect API and compatibility impacts, address normal review or CI findings, verify all user stories, and prepare the final set of pull requests or delivery artifacts.
